```{r}
# Paw-print scatterplot
crime_scene <- data %>% filter(record_type == "crime_scene")

ggplot(data, aes(paw_length_cm, paw_width_cm, label = name, color = name)) +
  geom_rect(
    data = crime_scene,
    aes(xmin = paw_length_lower_cm, xmax = paw_length_upper_cm,
        ymin = paw_width_lower_cm, ymax = paw_width_upper_cm),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = NA, color = "red", linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text_repel() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Sava Sniffer" = "#3399FF", "Klara Cache" = "#0000FF",
                               "Lady Byte" = "#660099", "Kommissar RegEx" = "#0099FF",
                               "Vera Vector" = "#9966CC", "Crime-scene sample" = "#CC0033")) +
  labs(x = "Paw length (cm)", y = "Paw width (cm)", title = "Paw-print analysis") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )
```
